# Intelligence: Override
Intelligence improves crafting and medical abilities. At [bold]10 effective Intelligence[/bold], you also gain [bold]Override[/bold]. Activate the Protectron action icon and select a target within [bold]two tiles[/bold]. While selecting a target, a green-and-black animated hand aura appears. This is purely cosmetic: it creates no item, occupies no hand, and grants no spell or combat effects. Cancelling the action removes it.
[bold]Electronic doors:[/bold] Override uses the existing emag lock-bypass behavior. The door must be designed to use electricity, but it can currently be unpowered. Wooden and other purely mechanical doors are excluded. Emag immunity still applies.
[bold]AI robots:[/bold] Reprogram a living AI-controlled robot to be friendly toward all players and other overridden robots, and hostile toward unhacked AI robots and the usual wasteland enemies. Player-controlled robots and player character bodies are protected. The conversion lasts for the robot's remaining life. It operates independently and does not follow you.
Override has [bold]unlimited uses[/bold] and a [bold]one-minute shared cooldown[/bold] after a successful door or robot hack. Invalid, out-of-range, immune, or already overridden targets do not consume the cooldown. Temporarily lowering Intelligence does not reset it.
